title: Contract Pricing Agreement: Price Protection Lines for Substitutes of Discontinued Items
content:
# Price protection lines for substitutes of discontinued items — Contract Pricing Agreement

**The rule.** This policy adds the price protection line of the Corbett-approved substitute that filled a backorder for a discontinued contract item of another item number: a line for the substitute's item number, with the change reason of a discontinued item's substitute, effective on the discontinuation date (the ship date of that substitute fill), at the protected price this policy works out. A substitute outside this policy's scope is not protected under it.

**Current basis.** For a substitute this policy protects, and only for such a substitute, the substitute is billed at the protected price this policy works out for the tier's discontinued item price protection period, in days, from the discontinuation date and is then added at its own quoted price or reverts to the discount basis; every other substitute of a discontinued contract item is still billed at the discontinued item's contract unit price for that protection period from the discontinuation and is then added at its own quoted price or reverts to the discount basis.

For a substitute line this policy adds, and only for such a line, no special pricing quote is involved and the line is added at the protected price; every other item is still added at the price of an accepted Corbett special pricing quote, returned within the tier's special pricing request period in business days of the request, and the quote is still accepted no later than the tier's special pricing quote validity period in calendar days after the quote date.

**When the price is set.** The substitute's protected price is not set until the records carry the close-out line of the discontinued item it replaces. Until such a close-out line is on the records, no protected price is set.

**What the recording does.** One contract item line is recorded for the substitute's item number: it takes effect on the effective date given at the protected contract unit price, records the unit price the customer was billed for the substitute on its regular shipment, carries the product category of the discontinued item it replaces, carries no list price or supplier cost (zero), and receives a newly issued change reference. The customer sees the substitute on the contract item list at the protected price.

## Invocation

An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `protect_substitute_price_656c6d72` and then calls it.

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `pricing_agreement_id` | Reference number of the customer's Contract Pricing Agreement, read from the pricing agreement lookup (id) |
| `sku` | Corbett item number of the substitute exactly as the customer's order records show it on the substitute shipments, copied character for character |
| `replaced_sku` | Corbett item number of the discontinued contract item the substitute replaces, exactly as the agreement's contract item records show it, copied character for character |
| `contract_unit_price` | The protected contract unit price, USD, 4 decimal places, rounded half up |
| `prior_unit_price` | The unit price the customer was billed for the substitute on its latest regular shipment, USD, 4 decimal places |
| `effective_date` | The ship date from which the protected price applies, YYYY-MM-DD |

## Return

On success: `status` ("protected" when the line was written), `contract_item_id` (reference number of the new contract item line), `sku` (the substitute's item number), `effective_date` (YYYY-MM-DD), `contract_unit_price` (USD, 4 decimal places) and `change_reference` (the change reference issued).
